items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So he and I put in our notice and we went up to Madison to play with this band, with Don Phillips.

ctx.x: The other saxophone player said, 'well -- I've got a summer job up in Madison, Wisconsin with a fellow out of Fort Wayne named Don Phillips. Would you like to come along and play first saxophone? When we were with the Ravens, they paid $5.00 a night. And in those days you could get a room for 50 cents a night, if you doubled up it was 25 cents. And you could get a steak dinner for 35 cents, so I used to save $3.00 a week. But this job in Madison they said, we'll pay you $60.00 a week. Well, gosh, that was…
So he and I put in our notice and we went up to Madison to play with this band, with Don Phillips.
